title: UI风格#108 - Holographic Minimal (全息极简)
description: 创建第108种UI风格：全息极简风格 - 虹彩极简、微妙光泽、未来极简。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDD.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Holographic Minimal style When color palette Then features holographic silver, iridescent white, soft rainbow, transparent layers
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#E8E8E8 (银白), #F8F8FF (虹彩), #FFE4E1 (柔光), #F5F5F5 (透明白), #C8C8C8 (灰银)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Holographic Minimal style When typography Then uses clean fonts: Inter, Satoshi, or Plus Jakarta Sans
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Inter (正文), Satoshi (标题), Plus Jakarta Sans (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Holographic Minimal style When layout Then clean whitespace, subtle iridescence, floating elements, minimal grid
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：留白空间、微妙虹彩、浮动元素、简约网格

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Holographic Minimal style When UI elements Then rainbow refraction, metallic sheen, transparency shifts, prismatic edges
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：彩虹折射、金属光泽、透明变化、棱镜边缘

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Holographic Minimal UI When functional Then includes minimal chat, aura agents, essence stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：极简聊天、光环代理、本质统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Holographic Minimal UI When copy Then uses essential language: 'Essence', 'Aura', 'Prism', 'Lumin'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'ESSENCE. AURA. PRISM.'、按钮'SEND'→'LUMIN'、'SUBMIT'→'REFINE'
